verdict.rationale: PayPal exposes webhooks that fire HTTPS events for account/transaction changes, which a developer can use to build custom automated actions via backend code, but there is no built-in no-code rule engine or 'if event then action' automation layer for end users to define directly. missing for 10: native rule/automation builder, no-code trigger-action mapping, evidence of AI-native users defining rules without writing backend integration code.
